title: I oati te māra i te ata
intro: I ngā hāora marino i mua i te whitinga o te rā, i whakatakotoria he mahere huna. I tū mai he taonga tuku iho whai rawa mō te kotinga, engari i puta he whakatau kia kaua e tukua kia tae atu ngā hua katoa ki te hunga e matea ana. I te ata, ka āhua tauhou ngā mea katoa, ā, ka whaowhaohia he akoranga ki ngā manga mangu mō te hunga katoa e whakaaroaro ana.
clues: I riro mai i a mātou tētahi māra momona, ā, i oati mātou ki te hauhake i ngā hua katoa o taua mā mātou anō.
I oati mātou kia haere wawe atu i te atatu, i te mea kei te moe tonu te hunga rawakore i tono mai mō tā rātou hea.
I whakakorehia e mātou tētahi tūāpapa i roto i tā mātou oati, ā, i puritia e mātou te tika o te hunga rawakore, me te kore e kī mēnā ka pai a Allah.
I haere mātou ki waho me te kōrero pōhēhē tetahi ki tetahi, kia kaua tetahi tangata rawakore e tukua kia tomo ki roto i tā mātou māra i taua rā.
I whakaaro mātou e taea e mātou te kohikohi i ngā mea katoa, me te aukati i tētahi kaikohi kei tango i tētahi wāhanga.
I oho ake mātou, ā, kua pakaru tā mātou māra i te pō, kua mangu katoa me te mea kua hauhaketia, ā, ka mea mātou kua tangohia mātou, kua ripeneta hoki.

options: Ngā Hoa o te Āwhata
Ngā Hoa o te Māra
Ngā Karere o te Tāone i roto i te Surah Ya-Sin
Te Iwi o te Arewhana
Ngā Kaitiaki o te Ahi Reinga

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te patu i te kau hei whakatau i tētahi tautohe kohuru
Te wero i tētahi poropiti kia tukua iho ngā kōhatu i te rangi
Te whakatakoto mahere ki te hauhake i te atatu, me te whakakore i te wāhi mō te hunga rawakore
Te takahi i te Hāpati mā te whakatakoto kupenga hī ika
Te hanga i tētahi tāhuna hei whakahaere i ngā waipuke mō ngā mahi hokohoko
trial.answer: Te whakatakoto mahere ki te hauhake i te atatu, me te whakakore i te wāhi mō te hunga rawakore

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: Ko te awaawa tapu o Tuwa te wāhi i kitea ai te ahi
Ko te māra hua taiepa hei hauhake i te ata
Ko te papa whakaata o te whare kingi i pohehetia he wai
Ko te āka rakau i hangaia i raro i te tohutohu a te Atua
Ko te taiepa rino i hangaia i waenganui i ngā maunga e rua
location.answer: Ko te māra hua taiepa hei hauhake i te ata

outcome.label: Hua
options: I hurihia mātou hei makimaki mō te takahi i te Hāpati
E toru rau e iwa tau mātou i moe ai i roto i tētahi ana
I horomia tātou e te whenua me ngā taonga mō te whakapehapeha
I whakangaromia tā mātou māra i te pō kotahi, ā, i pouri haere pērā i te pō
I toremi mātou ki te moana i a mātou e whai ana i te hunga whakapono
outcome.answer: I whakangaromia tā mātou māra i te pō kotahi, ā, i pouri haere pērā i te pō

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
